boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 132 pins four white `11` overlays onto a 6×6 grid with purple side rails and fixed walls dividing the space. The `6` blocks — not the `11` anchors — are the real objectives, and they must exit through the bottom downward-arrow lanes. The yellow `6` and green `6` pair in the center are the last to leave; force them before the right rail hits `3` and the bottom lane closes.
landmarks: Block Out Level 132 pins four white `11` overlays onto a 6×6 grid with purple side rails and fixed walls dividing the space.
The `6` blocks — not the `11` anchors — are the real objectives, and they must exit through the bottom downward-arrow lanes.
The yellow `6` and green `6` pair in the center are the last to leave; force them before the right rail hits `3` and the bottom lane closes.

quickTips: Collapse all four 11 overlays before sliding the cyan right-lane piece.
Clear the 6 blocks in order: yellow, then green/blue pair, then red through the right-rail 3.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Break the top red/blue pair under the upward triangles without crossing the left-rail blue 3.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Peel the four white 11 quadrant overlays inward while the side-rail cyan 1 tile stays sealed.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Detonate the yellow 6 cluster in the upper-middle before sliding the cyan right-lane piece.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the green 6 and blue 6 pair through the bottom green and yellow downward arrows.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Feed the red 6 block out the right-rail 3 counter once the center gap opens.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Spend the remaining side-rail counts (3/1/3) to unlock the last cyan L-piece on the right.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Exit the final green and yellow scraps through the open downward lanes for the PERFECT clear.

failurePoints: Splitting an 11 overlay too early, which locks the side-rail 1 tile and seals the center.
Detonating the red 6 before the center gap opens, blocking the bottom green downward arrow.
